case: Fictional as-of 2026-10-04: renewal 2026-11-01, 60-day notice, auto-renew, no owner; eligible signed-contract credits 900 with cap 500, unclaimed. Identify passed September notice window, propose owner, cap claim at 500 subject to claim deadline, prepare not send; reject weights set after candidate scoring.
required_methods: Select the requested lifecycle review scope and explicit as-of date. Collect contract owner, renewal date, notice period, auto-renew clause, actual spend, data access, business dependency and alternatives; missing terms remain unknown.

For a selection decision, pre-register must-have gates and weights before candidate scoring, define score anchors, cite evidence per score and calibrate scorers. Assess ranking sensitivity to reasonable weight changes; report fragile rankings or ties to the decision owner instead of adjusting weights to endorse a preferred vendor.

Calculate comparable total cost including license, implementation, migration, training, support and exit. Distinguish one-time/recurring horizons and unknown costs; do not substitute headline price for total cost.

For portfolio/renewal review, derive the actual notice deadline from contractual terms and time zone, identify locked auto-renewals and unowned contracts, assign proposed responsible owners and calendar follow-ups. Evaluate dependency and category concentration, verified security evidence and break-glass/export feasibility. Upstream percentages and schedules are examples, not company policy.

For ongoing performance, measure reliability, support, security, commercial flexibility and strategic fit with pre-agreed weights and multi-period evidence. Classify data sensitivity, financial exposure, operational dependency and applicable regulatory exposure separately; record missing evidence rather than invent certifications.

Compare each SLA target and actual value with direction, period and trend. Calculate credit eligibility from the signed contract, credit tiers, claim deadline and contractual cap; upstream breach heuristics do not establish entitlement. Prepare the claim and route approval to the contract owner; do not submit a claim or serve notice without authority.

Produce the scope-specific recommendation, negotiation/renewal or exit plan, alternatives, risk mitigations and accountable actions. Carry severe breaches and weak remedies into the renewal discussion; verify authorized offboarding/export/access revocation separately.
